description: Live host API transitions driven by shared JSON settings. Python, Node and the browser workspace wrapper run the same scenarios; the browser wrapper is exercised under Node with its WASM shell parser.

script.source: function preCommand(ctx) { if (ctx.command.name === 'echo') return {deny: 'js gate'}; return null; }
function preCommand(ctx) { if (ctx.command.name === 'echo') return {deny: 'js gate'}; return null; }

steps.command: cd /work; export SAVED=yes; keep() { echo function; }
n=0; while true; do sleep 30 & n=$((n+1)); done; echo no
for f in A1 A2 A3; do sleep 0.01; echo "A:$f"; done
eval 'for f in B1 B2 B3; do sleep 0.01; echo "B:$f"; done'
for ((i=0;i<9000;i++)); do eval ':'; done; echo BAD > /data/late
for ((i=0;i<9000;i++)); do echo hi | cat > /dev/null; done; echo BAD > /data/late
sleep 0.01; eval 'pwd'; printf 'left\n' > value; cat value
eval 'pwd'; printf 'right\n' > value; sleep 0.02; cat value
echo left > /data/rendezvous-left; for i in $(seq 500); do [ -f /data/rendezvous-right ] && break; sleep 0.01; done; cat /data/rendezvous-right
echo right > /data/rendezvous-right; for i in $(seq 500); do [ -f /data/rendezvous-left ] && break; sleep 0.01; done; cat /data/rendezvous-left
for i in $(seq 1 5000); do echo x; sleep 0.001; done &
